lines.text: مشتري | و | نیکست دیدار اشراف و قضاة و حاجت از ایشان خواستن
lines.en: Jupiter | and | It is good to meet nobles and judges and to ask them for needs.

lines.text: زهره | ه | نیکست عشرت و نو بریدن و پوشیدن
lines.en: Venus | h | It is good for pleasure and cutting and wearing new clothes.

lines.text: زحل | ح | حذر کردن از پادشاه
lines.en: Saturn | ḥ | Beware of the king.

lines.text: عطارد | و | نیکست دیدار اهل مناصب و وزراء و زرگری کردن
lines.en: Mercury | and | It is good to meet people of office and ministers and to do goldsmithing.

lines.text: مریخ | ز | نیکست فصد و حجامت و بیمار پرسیدن و داغ نهادن
lines.en: Mars | z | It is good for phlebotomy and cupping and visiting the sick and branding.

lines.text: عطارد | - | نیکست کودک بکتاب دادن و کودک از شیر باز داشتن
lines.en: Mercury | - | It is good to send a child to school and to wean a child.

lines.text: زهره | - | نیکست لهو و طرب و نو بریدن و پوشیدن و تعلیم موسیقی
lines.en: Venus | - | It is good for amusement and joy and cutting and wearing new clothes and teaching music.

lines.text: مشتري | و | نیکست دیدار قضاة و وزراء و تعلیم علوم و حاجت از اشراف
lines.en: Jupiter | and | It is good to meet judges and ministers and to teach sciences and to ask nobles for needs.

lines.text: مریخ | - | نیکست ترتیب لشکر و تعلیم سلاح و دیدن امرا و اشراف
lines.en: Mars | - | It is good to arrange the army and teach weapons and meet commanders and nobles.

lines.text: زحل | - | حذر از دیدن اکابر
lines.en: Saturn | - | Beware of meeting the great ones.

lines.text: زحل | و | نیکست قصد دشمن کردن و ترکیب دارو و مسهل کردن
lines.en: Saturn | and | It is good to intend the enemy and mix medicine and take a laxative.

lines.text: عطارد | ح | نیکست ابتدا تعلیم و محاسبه و مناظره دیوانی
lines.en: Mercury | ḥ | It is good to begin teaching and accounting and courtly debate.

lines.text: مشتري | - | گزیده است عقد بستن و تعلیم و نقل و حرکت کردن و نو بریدن و پوشیدن
lines.en: Jupiter | - | It is chosen to tie a knot and teach and move and travel and cut and wear new clothes.

lines.text: زهره | - | نیکست عیش و تماش و گرمابه زدن و بیعت و تجدید حشمت
lines.en: Venus | - | It is good for pleasure and watching and going to the bath and allegiance and renewing dignity.

lines.text: مریخ | - | از جمله اعمال حذر خاصه از سفر و مخاصمت کردن
lines.en: Mars | - | Beware of all actions, especially traveling and quarreling.

lines.text: مریخ | و | هیچ کار را نشاید الا دارو خوردن و ترکیب زهرها کردن
lines.en: Mars | and | No work is suitable except taking medicine and mixing poisons.

lines.text: زهره | و | نیکست دیدار زنان و اهل طرب و تماش و عشرت کردن
lines.en: Venus | and | It is good to meet women and people of joy and watch and have pleasure.

lines.text: عطارد | ح | دیدن اهل قلم را شاید و مناظره دیوانی
lines.en: Mercury | ḥ | It is suitable to meet people of the pen and courtly debate.

lines.text: مشتري | ه | نیکست عمارت کردن خصوص عمارت کاریز
lines.en: Jupiter | h | It is good to build, especially building a qanat.

lines.text: زحل | و | نیکست غدر و شبیخون بر دشمن زدن
lines.en: Saturn | and | It is good for treachery and night attack on the enemy.

summary.headline: Planetary Mansion Indications
summary.text: A sequence of planetary mansion indications assigns favorable or unfavorable actions, including meeting nobles, judges, ministers, commanders, and women; pleasure, clothing, music, teaching, travel, medicine, phlebotomy, cupping, military organization, poisons, and qanat construction.
